scope: Official course counts verified from each platform's official public catalogue

plat-2.name: Agora
plat-2.evidence: Official catalogue requires JavaScript and does not expose an exact public course total in the rendered HTML; UNICEF describes over a thousand learning opportunities, which are not all courses.

plat-3.name: IBM Skills Build
plat-3.evidence: Official catalogue exposes exact counts for individual filters (for example 75 AI courses) but no exact unfiltered university-course total was publicly exposed, so category counts were not summed because overlap cannot be ruled out.

plat-4.name: Forage
plat-4.evidence: Official catalogue displays: Displaying 1 - 16 of 286 Job Simulations. Forage uses job simulations rather than courses as its primary catalogue unit.

plat-5.name: Microsoft
plat-5.evidence: Microsoft Learn course-only catalogue displays 144 results.
